Rule Explanation: Copies ACCOUNTCAL.refcustomerid into the customer-wise balance cohort when CUSTOMERCAL.FlgProcessing is 'N' and the account joins to CUSTOMERCAL on refcustomerid; otherwise retains existing refcustomerid.

Aggregates ACCOUNTCAL balances into the customer-wise balance staging cohort when CUSTOMERCAL.FlgProcessing is 'N' and refcustomerid matches across account and customer; otherwise retains existing Balance.

Assigns DbtDt across prioritized conditions:
1. Cohort reset: Clears DbtDt to NULL for degraded customers in the customer-wise balance cohort.
2. Bucket dates: Populates DbtDt with ADDDAY-based bucket start dates from SysNPA_Dt when the customer enters DB1/DB2 stages.
3. Loss accounts: Resets DbtDt to NULL when SysAssetClassAlt_Key matches LOS.
Clears LossDt to NULL for degraded customers (FlgDeg 'Y', FlgProcessing 'N') in the customer-wise balance cohort; otherwise retains existing LossDt.
Sets DegDate to @ProcessDate for degraded customers (FlgDeg 'Y', FlgProcessing 'N') in the balance cohort; otherwise retains existing DegDate.

Rule Explanation:
Assigns SysAssetClassAlt_Key across prioritized conditions:
1. Fraud / special category (870): Sets SysAssetClassAlt_Key to the LOS (loss) DimAssetClass key when any SplCatg1–4 Alt_Key is 870 and FlgDeg is 'Y'.
2. NPA aging buckets: Assigns SUB, DB1, DB2, or DB3 asset-class keys from SysNPA_Dt plus @SUB_Days, @DB1_Days, and @DB2_Days compared to @ProcessDate.

Sets FinalAssetClassAlt_Key from CUSTOMERCAL.SysAssetClassAlt_Key when the account Asset_Norm is NORMAL, account FlgDeg is 'Y', and the customer is in the degraded processing cohort (FlgDeg 'Y', FlgProcessing 'N'); otherwise retains existing FinalAssetClassAlt_Key.
Sets COMPLETED to 'Y' when ACLRUNNINGPROCESSSTATUS.RUNNINGPROCESSNAME equals 'Update_AssetClass'; otherwise retains existing COMPLETED.
Resets ERRORDATE to NULL when ACLRUNNINGPROCESSSTATUS.RUNNINGPROCESSNAME equals 'Update_AssetClass'; otherwise retains existing ERRORDATE.
Resets ERRORDESCRIPTION to NULL when ACLRUNNINGPROCESSSTATUS.RUNNINGPROCESSNAME equals 'Update_AssetClass'; otherwise retains existing ERRORDESCRIPTION.
Increments COUNT by 1 when ACLRUNNINGPROCESSSTATUS.RUNNINGPROCESSNAME equals 'Update_AssetClass'; otherwise retains existing COUNT.
